app.name: Public transport (SE)
app.summary: Swedish departures with destinations, realtime updates and walking time, powered by Trafiklab.
app.stop_hint: Choose a result from the name search. The ID is kept automatically.
app.line_hint: Lines in the next hour. Unset means all; resetting requires a new tile in Tessera 0.4.88.
app.walk_hint: Skip departures leaving before you can walk there. The countdown still shows departure time.
app.late_hint: A departure that runs a minute or more late gets "+2" behind where it goes.
app.line2_hint: Optional second line from the same stop. Select lines again after changing stops.
app.api_key_hint: A key for Trafiklab Realtime APIs. Kept in Tessera, never on the screen.
app.direction_hint: Exact destination text; leave empty for both directions.
app.search_hint: Enter a name and leave the field, then choose a result below. After changing the search, select the stop again.
